Groups root comments by a facet value, rendering each group as a collapsible section with a count summary. Controlled — mutations route through the supplied callbacks.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/comments/GroupedComments.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { GroupedComments } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/comments";
```
